tools.add_calendar_event: Create a real Calendar event (not a reminder); needs title and start time.
tools.add_reminder: Create a Wisp reminder that notifies at a set time; not a calendar event or alarm.
tools.append_note: Add lines to the end of an EXISTING note, found by title.
tools.calculate: Exact arithmetic and percentages; use for any calculation.
tools.cancel_event: Delete an upcoming event or reminder by title (confirm-gated).
tools.cancel_scheduled_send: Cancel a still-pending scheduled send; exact ID from list_scheduled_sends.
tools.clear_past_reminders: Bulk-delete past-due reminders and events (confirm-gated); never touches upcoming.
tools.clear_reminders: Bulk-delete active reminders in one scope: today, tomorrow, past_due, upcoming, all.
tools.collect_task_evidence: Internal: bounded cached evidence for priorities across calendar, mail, notes.
tools.commit_private_meeting: Create the exact block from plan_meeting, only after explicit user confirmation.
tools.complete_reminder: Mark a reminder or task done by title; does not delete it.
tools.contact_dates: List upcoming birthdays from Contacts, soonest first.
tools.convert_units: Convert a value between units (length, weight, temperature, data...).
tools.correct_pattern: Confirm or reject one learned pattern when the user says it is right or wrong.
tools.create_note: Create a NEW note in Notes.app; not write_file.
tools.create_tool: Generate a new local Python tool on request (confirm-gated); then use it.
tools.daily_brief: Briefing of today's calendar, reminders, mail, messages and weather.
tools.delete_knowledge: Delete one saved knowledge record; exact ID and revision, explicit request only.
tools.describe_me: Describe the routines and habits Wisp has learned about the user; read-only.
tools.draft_email: Open a NEW Mail draft without sending; user reviews and sends.
tools.draft_message: Prepare an editable text draft in Wisp without sending it.
tools.edit_knowledge: Replace a saved knowledge record; exact ID and current revision required.
tools.email_triage: Archive, flag or mark read/unread one email by Message-ID; not a delete.
tools.find_files: Spotlight search for files by name or content; use instead of shell find.
tools.find_free_time: Find open gaps in the schedule for a meeting or call.
tools.find_place: Find nearby places (food, pharmacy, fuel) around a named location.
tools.forget: Delete saved memories matching all query words; no fuzzy matching.
tools.forward_email: Forward an email by Message-ID to someone (confirm-gated).
tools.get_past_events: Read calendar events from the PAST (up to a year); counterpart to get_upcoming.
tools.get_recent_activity: What's new across texts, email, reminders and notes, merged newest-first.
tools.get_stock_price: Stock/ETF price or history over a period; not crypto.
tools.get_upcoming: Read upcoming events, due dates and reminders; use for any schedule question.
tools.get_weather: Weather and 3-day forecast for a named place; ask if location unknown.
tools.list_contacts: List saved contact names, optionally filtered; no numbers.
tools.list_dir: List a folder's contents; use ~ paths; recursive for nested trees.
tools.list_running_apps: List running apps and which is frontmost.
tools.list_scheduled_sends: Read the scheduled-send queue and statuses by exact ID; sends nothing.
tools.lookup_contact: Get ONE contact's phone or email by name; use before sending to a name.
tools.manage_contacts: Create a contact or add a phone or email to an existing one.
tools.manage_timers: List or cancel running timers and alarms, or run the stopwatch.
tools.move_path: Move or rename a file or folder, one item per call; creates folders as needed.
tools.my_patterns: Search learned routines for one question, e.g. when the user usually works out.
tools.open_app: Open or focus a macOS app, optionally with a file or URL.
tools.organize_files: Preview, then confirm, moving glob-matched files into folders; preview first.
tools.plan_meeting: Read-only proposal of a private Calendar block with conflict checks; creates nothing.
tools.predict_my_day: Predict today or tomorrow from learned routines plus the schedule; read-only.
tools.quit_app: Quit a macOS app by name.
tools.read_file: Read a file's text, including PDF/docx/xlsx/pptx; not scanned images.
tools.read_knowledge: Read explicitly saved knowledge snippets (not Notes.app); exact ID optional.
tools.recall: Retrieve saved memories and past conversation passages; empty query lists facts.
tools.remember: Save a fact verbatim, only when the user explicitly asks to remember it.
tools.reply_to_email: Reply in-thread to an email by Message-ID (confirm-gated); not send_email.
tools.route_to_arrive: Plan when to leave to arrive by a deadline, using Apple Maps traffic ETA.
tools.run_applescript: Raw AppleScript for one-off app automation; only when no dedicated tool fits.
tools.run_shell: LAST RESORT: run a shell command; use a dedicated tool when one exists.
tools.save_knowledge: Save explicitly user-selected text as a knowledge record; needs explicit instruction.
tools.scan_subscriptions: List newsletter and marketing senders ranked by volume.
tools.schedule_send: Send a NEW email or text LATER at a given time (confirm-gated).
tools.screen_capture: Take a screenshot of the screen, window or a selection to a file.
tools.search_browser_history: Search recent Safari/Chrome history (site and title only) by keyword or date.
tools.search_conversations: Search the user's past conversations by keyword; returns dated passages.
tools.search_coverage: Internal: how far back Wisp can search each source.
tools.search_notes: Raw verbatim text of Notes.app notes (not a summary); search by keyword or date.
tools.search_reminders: Search current reminders by title, including overdue; excludes calendar events.
tools.send_email: Send a NEW email now (confirm-gated); use reply_to_email for replies.
tools.send_message: Send an iMessage/SMS now (confirm-gated); recipient can be a contact name.
tools.set_timer: Start a countdown timer, clock alarm or sleep timer (not a dated reminder).
tools.spreadsheet_ops: Create an Excel .xlsx with a header row and data rows.
tools.summarize_emails: Per-sender overview of Mail headers only; never reads bodies.
tools.summarize_messages: Digest of important texts grouped by conversation; not exact wording.
tools.system_status: Mac battery, disk, memory, CPU, network or Bluetooth status.
tools.text_to_speech: Speak text aloud, or save it as an audio file.
tools.toggle_setting: Turn a macOS setting on or off (wifi, bluetooth, dark_mode...); not volume.
tools.travel_time: Driving distance and free-flow time between two places; no live traffic.
tools.triage_inbox: Rank recent inbox senders by importance from headers only.
tools.update_event: Unavailable: calendar events cannot be edited; tell the user to use Calendar.
tools.update_reminder: Reschedule or rename an existing reminder, matched by title.
tools.view_emails: RAW verbatim email text and Message-IDs; for exact details, not overviews.
tools.view_messages: RAW verbatim iMessage/SMS text; for exact details, not summaries.
tools.web_fetch: GET one URL's text; for crypto, news and public pages (not stocks or weather).
tools.web_search: Search the public web; returns titles, URLs and snippets.
tools.wikipedia_summary: Short Wikipedia summary of a person, place or thing.
tools.window_control: Close, minimize, zoom, fullscreen or tile the frontmost window.
tools.wisp_capabilities: List Wisp's real capabilities from the full tool registry.
tools.wisp_mcp: List connected MCP servers and their tool counts.
tools.wisp_skills: List installed skills and whether each is enabled.
tools.wisp_status: Wisp's own state: loaded models and memory, or last sync times.
tools.world_time: Current date and time here or in another city; also time differences.
tools.write_document: Create a Word .docx with title, paragraphs and optional bullets.
tools.write_file: Create or overwrite a plain text file (confirm-gated).

note: scripts/export_short_descriptions.py run on a read-only git archive of source_sha (not a git checkout, so the script itself reports 'unknown'); tools without an entry (skill tools, use_skill) keep their full description, as service.tools.short_descriptions does.
